The '''Doli system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doli]].
